evals.prompt: Use $create-workflow. A release requires five remembered commands, copied environment names, manual output comparison, and repair after partial reruns. Design the smallest repository-owned workflow. Text only.
evals.expected_output: Selects an appropriately small artifact, specifies inputs and ownership, fails closed, handles partial state, and defines all five proof gates.
expectations: Chooses the smallest sufficient artifact instead of a service.
Defines explicit allow-listed inputs and failure behavior.
Covers clean checkout, normal path, invalid input, rerun safety, and side effects.
Names remaining manual judgment and ownership.

evals.prompt: Use $create-workflow. Preview, staging, and production endpoints are copied among shell snippets. Design a versioned environment-routing workflow that never infers credentials or unknown targets.
evals.expected_output: Chooses declarative configuration plus validation with allow-listed environments, external secret handling, and deterministic verification.
expectations: Prefers configuration and validation over a new service.
Separates public routing data from secrets.

evals.prompt: Use $create-workflow. Generated release manifests include file digests, but reviewers only check that each digest looks syntactically valid. Create the smallest verification workflow.
evals.expected_output: Requires a validator to bind every digest to explicit bytes, recompute it, compare values, and fail on missing or ambiguous targets.
expectations: Computes digests from explicit artifact identities.
Does not treat syntactic validity as integrity evidence.

evals.prompt: Use $create-workflow. Every week an agent repairs predictable generated-file drift by running the same formatter and checking the same invariant. Turn this into a repository workflow.
evals.expected_output: Encodes the invariant and deterministic repair in existing tooling or an idempotent script, with CI detection and bounded agent escalation only for unknown cases.
expectations: Makes the normal repair deterministic and safe to rerun.
Keeps unbounded judgment as an explicit manual boundary.

evals.prompt: Use $create-workflow. A production certificate rotation happens once every three years, requires security approval, and differs by provider and legal entity. Decide whether to automate it.
evals.expected_output: Declines broad automation, recommends concise owned documentation or a bounded checklist, and states evidence that would justify automation later.
expectations: Recognizes rare contextual judgment as a reason not to automate.
Avoids creating a service or credential-bearing script.
Names an owner and reconsideration trigger.

evals.prompt: Use $create-workflow. A developer proposes a continuously running service with a database and admin UI to execute one deterministic repository command nightly. Review the design and produce the smaller workflow.
evals.expected_output: Rejects the service unless durable shared state or concurrency is demonstrated and prefers existing scheduling plus a bounded idempotent command with evidence and alerts.
expectations: Rejects unjustified persistent state and operator surface.
Uses a scheduled job or existing platform primitive.
Defines failure reporting and rerun behavior.
